source.title: Broken relative links in @n8n/expression-runtime docs (README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md)

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
## Bug Description

Three relative links in the `@n8n/expression-runtime` package docs 404 on GitHub. The
package used to live at `packages/expression-runtime`; after it moved to
`packages/@n8n/expression-runtime`, these two relative paths stopped resolving:

- `packages/@n8n/expression-runtime/README.md`, License section:
  `[LICENSE.md](../../LICENSE.md)` resolves to `packages/LICENSE.md` (does not exist).
  The license file is at the repository root: `LICENSE.md`.
- `packages/@n8n/expression-runtime/README.md`, Related section:
  `[n8n workflow package](../workflow/)` resolves to `packages/@n8n/workflow/` (does not
  exist). The workflow package is at `packages/workflow`.
- `packages/@n8n/expression-runtime/ARCHITECTURE.md`, References section:
  `[n8n workflow package](../workflow/)` — same as above.

GitHub renders relative links against the file's directory, so all three show
"Page not found" for readers.

## To Reproduce

1. Open https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/packages/%40n8n/expression-runtime/README.md
2. Click the `LICENSE.md` link in the License section -> 404.
3. Click `n8n workflow package` in the Related section -> 404.
4. Same for the References section of
   https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/packages/%40n8n/expression-runtime/ARCHITECTURE.md

## Expected behavior

All relative links resolve:
- `../../../LICENSE.md` -> repository root `LICENSE.md`
- `../../workflow/` -> `packages/workflow`

## Environment

- Commit `master` @ `251c44bc5e072afcc3daab3c3d1baf525afd8d41` (2026-11-14)
- GitHub web rendering of relative links

I have a small docs fix ready (3 link paths) and will link a PR here shortly. (Prepared with the help of an AI coding assistant; verified with a repo-wide relative-link check.)
